definitionEn: having yellow or very light hair

definitionEn: having brown or black hair

definitionEn: hair that does not curl

definitionEn: with little or no hair on the head

definitionEn: hair that grows above a man's mouth

definitionEn: lines on the skin that come with age

definitionEn: a mark left on the skin after a cut heals

definitionEn: of less than average height

definitionEn: attractive in appearance

definitionEn: unpleasant to look at

definitionEn: having lived for only a short time
